item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud kyi lta ba spyi gcod kyi rtsa ba'i glad [~klad] don, rgyud bu chung bcu gnyis
item.coloph: sprul pa'i sku'i las can gshen la bsten / … sprul pa'i [9r] sku nyid nam mkha' la dgongs pa mkha' la gzha' yal ba bzhin du gshegs so / gyer spungs nyid dgongs pa mkha' ltar grol lo / de nas rim par rgyud nas da lta bdag ngo sho tshul rgyal 'o
item.note: in this colophon, "myself" is identified as ngo-sho tshul-rgyal (tshul-khrims rgyal-mtshan), the ultimate recipient of the lineage (probably the spiritual great-grandfather of tre-ston rgyal-mtshan dpal in the zhang zhung snyan rgyud lineage supplied in brgyud rim; if so, he must have flourished in about 1400).

item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud las rgyud bu chung bcu gnyis
